第十一章 超青藏高原79（第1页）
十六、白湖狙击王中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界智之勇者小男孩唐琼凯、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界大熊猫兽小男孩胡伟知道历史记录。
那段历史是这样记录的——翔天等人打听灵魂徽章的消息，来到传说白湖，得知附近有一个叫狙击王的魔神手下在玩狙击打猎的游戏，把变成候鸟的村民们当成猎物虐待。
翔天等人不能袖手旁观，直接和狙击王展开激战。那是没有逆转时空之前的原始历史。
现在不同了。中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界勇之者小男孩翔天、中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界力之勇者小男孩亚树、中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界智之勇小女孩田奈奈、中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界引导者猫人族小女孩美雅听从中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界智之勇者小男孩唐琼凯、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界大熊猫兽小男孩胡伟的安排，一起对抗空灵族狙击王。
狙击王是莫雷麾下的空灵族，驾驶着一台狙击型机甲，机甲右臂是一支超长距离的能量狙击炮，左臂装着热感应追踪装置。
他蹲守在传说白湖对面的山崖上，将变成候鸟的村民们当成猎物狙击取乐。
中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界勇之者小男孩翔天召唤烈风，中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界智之勇小女孩田奈奈召唤流影飞狐。
流影飞狐的流影箭封锁狙击王的射击角度，烈风正面突进。中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界力之勇者小男孩亚树召唤震地龙，从地下绕到狙击王背后破土而出。
狙击王机甲在三面夹击中丧失战斗力，狙击王失败了。变成候鸟的村民们恢复了原形，纷纷飞回白湖的对岸。

Chapter 11 Super Qinghai-Tibet Plateau 79 (Page 1)
16. White Lake Sniper King Huang Xuejing, a little girl with Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World, Yang Xinying, a little girl with power in the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World, Tang Qiongkai, a little boy with Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World Wisdom, and Hu Wei, a little boy with Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World and giant panda beast, know the historical records.
That period of history is recorded like this - Xiangtian and others inquired about the soul badge, came to the legendary White Lake, and learned that there was a demon god called the Sniper King nearby who was playing a sniper hunting game, and treated the villagers who had turned into migratory birds as prey and abused them.
Xiangtian and others cannot stand by and start a fierce battle with the sniper king. That was the original history before time and space were reversed.
It's different now. China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warrior's Vitality Brave World Brave Boy Xiangtian, China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warrior's Vitality Brave World Power's brave boy Yashu, China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warrior's Vitality Brave World Wisdom Brave little girl Tian Nana, China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warrior's Vitality Brave World Leader Cat Human Race little girl Meiya listened to the arrangement of Huang Xuejing, a little girl from the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World, Yang Xinying, a little girl from the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World, a little boy Tang Qiongkai from the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World, and Hu Wei, a little boy from the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World Giant Panda Beast, to fight against the sniper king of the Void Clan.
The Sniper King is an ethereal tribe under Morey's command. He drives a sniper mecha. The right arm of the mecha is an ultra-long-range energy sniper cannon, and the left arm is equipped with a thermal tracking device.
He squatted on the cliff opposite the legendary White Lake, and sniped at the villagers who had turned into migratory birds as prey.
The young boy of the Chinese Low-Level Technology Thunderbolt Warrior's Vitality Brave World summons strong winds, and the Chinese Low-Level Technology Thunderbolt Warrior's Vitality Brave World's Wisdom Brave Little Girl Tian Nana summons the Liuying Flying Fox.
The Liuying Flying Fox's Liuying Arrow blocked the Sniper King's shooting angle, and Gale rushed forward. The young boy Yashu of China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warrior's Vitality Brave World Power summoned the Earthshaking Dragon, went around from the underground and broke out from behind the Sniper King.
The Sniper King mecha lost its combat effectiveness when attacked from three sides, and the Sniper King failed. The villagers who had turned into migratory birds returned to their original forms and flew back to the other side of the White Lake.
